name: Closing an iterator twice is idempotent and permanently done

input.source_text: module M { public fun run() -> Array { let a = [1, 2]; mut it = a.iterator(); let h = it.hash(); let first = it.close(); let second = it.close(); [first, second, it.next() == Iteration.done, it.next() == Iteration.done, it.hash() == h] } } M.run()
